m: Your *footsteps* go out at *sunrise* and your *thumb* presses the deal: you **get** what you came for.
Under the *leaning cliff* a *covered mouth* waits until everyone has gone, and speaks only **after**.
A *swarm* charges, but one *halberd* holds them off; the lone guard **becomes** a hero.
A *lid* sits on a compass box, and its needle swings to show the **direction**.
*Water drops* flow over the *soil*, and an *elbow* steers them into the field: a clever farming **method**.
A *woman* opens her *mouth* to bargain: "**If** you lower the price, I'll buy."
The *watcher* cries out as the *king* suddenly appears: he is here, right **now**.
A *big man* lifts the *plank* of the shutter: the sky is light, a new **day** has begun.
Laying *two planks* over the muddy *road* to the door, you step across and **enter**.
From a *podium* on the *hillside*, a *mouth* gives orders, and each **part** of the army moves.
A *sheep* grazing under a *tree*: you know it by its woolly **appearance**, the way it looks.
Hair streams down past the end of the *plank*, on and on: very **long**.
A *shirt* sewn from a soft *hide* is thrown over you: you are covered, acted on **by** someone else.
A *standing knife* cuts the *grain stalk* in one stroke: a fast harvest, a real **benefit**.
A *standing person* hands the *tethered arrow* to his son: the bow passes to the next **generation**.
A *standing person* stands by his *speech bubble*: his word is good, so you **believe** him.
A *seedling top* stitched on a *robe hem*, worn on the outside to **show** everyone.
*Icicles* make the queue *yawn* in the cold, again and again: the third **time** this week.
A *right hand* turns the thermometer and reads the mark: how many **degrees**.
The butcher finds the joint below the *ox horn* and the whole ox comes apart: the puzzle is **solved**.
*Scissors* cut a *drop* of ink out of the sentence, and its **meaning** changes.
Under the *sun*, at the *foot stop*, you read the *page* of the exam: the first **question**.
A *mouth* shouts, a *strong arm* grabs the *standing knife* away: "**Don't**!"
A *left hand* tries the *slide* again and again, and lands it **only then**, at the very end.
*Grain stalk* first, then the *mouth*, then the *king*: food passes step by step through the **process**.
Draw the *bow*, and *long hair* flies over a flat page: one **sheet** of paper.
In the *teepee*, an *elbow* nudges the *page* forward: "Follow me," and he **leads** the way.
A *stone* as hard as an *ox horn*: nothing can crack it, you can be **certain**.
A *knife* slices clean through the *bent cross* in one stroke: **cut**.
A man stands by the post, leaning on his bow, waiting for the right **time**.
A *picket fence* of buckles on your belt: hang your things on it and **bring** them along.
A *plank* nailed on a *cross*: someone's hard at work. What are you **doing**?
A *big man* stands on the *grass* under an *archway* of roses, sipping tea: very **British**.
A *left hand* spreads a *towel* on the table: a piece of **cloth**.
A *mouth* tangled in a *twisted vine* **calls** out your name.
*Horns* on top of one long pole: only a **single** animal left.
The *sun* lights *crumbs* and *bristles*, and each casts its **image** on the wall, like a film.
Under a *leaning cliff*, a *cross* is scratched on a *shell* to test its **quality**.
A *green shoot* in a *fence*: the gardeners gather round it as one **group**.
A *plank* under the *scaffold* of a great temple: the vast continent of **Asia**.
An *altar* stands on the *hillside* at the border, **between** two countries.
Air in through the *nose*, down to the *heart*: breathe slowly and **rest**.
*Twin blades* snip the *silk thread* and stretch it tight: a straight **line**.
A *runner* jumps the *open crate*, then a *halberd*: the higher he goes, **the more** he jumps.
The *sun* blazes on a *knife* and a *mouth* above the *embers*: everything **shines**.
A *stone* rolls back and forth under the *door bar*: grind away at a problem, **research** it.
A *grain stalk* is cut with a *bent knife* and the *crumbs* are labelled: give each one a **name**.
A *person* at the *stop sign* looks ahead, planning a business: an **enterprise**.
A *dog* dashes out of the *cave*: so **sudden**!
A *mouth* blows a *puff of breath* and calls out your ticket **number**.
A *mouth* in a *rice field* shouts as the farmer walks his round, seven days a **week**.
*Water drops* pour onto the *candle* flame, and you watch closely: **focus**.
*Grass* stems with knots marking each section of the year, and at each knot a holiday: a **festival**.
A *halberd* and a *standing knife* scratch lines on the ground before battle: drawing up the **plan**.
A *giant* with a gentle *heart*: kindness shows in his whole **attitude**.
A *door bar* and a *standing knife* press shapes into the *soil*: each mould makes one **type**.
A *cross* over a *mouth*, a *cane* raised: the teacher demands the **reason** for the mischief.
*Music* plays as *legs* walk over the *soil*, taking in everything around them: the **surroundings**.
A *silk thread* wound into a long *coiled rope*, one loop per year: the record of an **era**.
Under a *roof* on the *mountain*, a *pinned heart* hides what no one may know: a **secret**.
A *small speech bubble* rises over the *chipped axe*: he **tells** you what happened to it.
A *helping hand* drops a *pill* of charcoal onto the *embers* and blows: the pot gets **hot**.
A *lying man* under an *archway* sorts every *beetle* into trays, each where it **belongs**.
A child with *legs* dangling sits on an *open crate* of *candy* and eats it all, **even** the wrappers.
Under the *moon* a trader bangs his *war club* on the desk as his **stock** shares soar.
A *seedling top* sprouts beside a *silk skein* still pale and undyed: simple and **plain**.
In the *grass* a guard under a *blanket* hears a noise, bangs his *cane*, and his *mouth* and *speech bubble* call the **police**.
A *prowling dog* and a big *dog* chase through the *grass* and come back with the prize: **obtained**.
Something stuck *upstairs*, a *fortune stick* jammed in the lock: slide your **card** to open it.
A *sheep* climbs onto the *workbench* and eats one plank: now the work is one **short**.
A *small speech bubble* rises over a *shopping basket* of books marked with a *cross*: the child **reads** them one by one.
A *standing person* sits so still, his *bow* laid aside, calm and smiling: the **Buddha**.
In the *grass* a man with *grey hair* writes in the *sun*; his book makes him **famous**.
In the *cave*, a *fang* pokes a hole in the hide so your head goes through: now you can **wear** it.
Someone *yawns* as the clerk counts out the money, bill by bill: the **funds** for the project.
A *right hand* carves a *wood slice* by a *leaning cliff* and prints from it: the first **edition**.
*Rain* washes the path; a *kicking foot* and *trudging feet* splash, and a *mouth* gasps as the buried box is **revealed**.
A *towel* spread on the floor of the shed: your **seat** at the meeting.
You doze under the *blanket*, then your *heart* jumps: **suddenly**, the kettle screams.
A *tree* trunk split open by an *axe* so you can study its rings: you **analyze** it.
Down the *road*, past every *door* and *archway*, through the *grass*: one full **round**, from start to finish, one **time**.
Weaving a *silk skein* after a day in the *rice field*: you are so **tired**.
Pick every *chili* in the field, haul it to the *podium*, mark each with a *cross*: hard, endless **toil**.
A *standing person* is handed the *shoulder pole*: the load is now his **responsibility**.
Under a *lid* of canopies, a *towel* for sale at every stall: the market that grew into a **city**.
